mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (below 4.5%) signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts rate (HOUST) above 1,600,000 units signals strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 275.0 (annualized inflation rate exceeding 4.5%) triggers a monetary policy tightening expectation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 275.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) combined with a stable or falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy amid high inflation, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or falls, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and corporate margin expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0), the supply chain is constrained, leading to higher inflation and reduced corporate output, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.
